name: NbS Suitability Explorer
question: Where should each solution go?
plain: Draw or upload your study area, tell the tool what matters most, and get a map for each Nature-based Solution showing where it fits best, with benefits, costs and priority sites.

name: Catchment geohydrological model
question: What happens to floods, recharge and evaporation?
plain: A digital twin of your catchment that follows rain from the sky to the river and into the ground, so you can test Nature-based Solutions over years and under future climates.

name: NbS+C Groundwater Model
question: How will groundwater respond?
plain: Builds a working groundwater model for your area automatically, so you can see how the water table responds to recharge, wells and Nature-based Solutions.

name: SWAT+ with MODFLOW or gwflow
question: With or without the measure?
plain: Surface water and groundwater solved together, so the hidden benefits of Nature-based Solutions, like recharge and summer river flow, show up in the numbers.

name: nbsmonitor
question: Is it working, year after year?
plain: Follows your Nature-based Solution from space, season after season: is the vegetation growing, is the water there, is the site recovering?

name: CRIDA-NbS Studio
question: Which plan holds up in a changing climate?
plain: A workshop tool where stakeholders build their own plan on a real, calibrated catchment model, see the outcomes, test them against future climate and compare them with an automatic optimiser.

name: Water quality & PFAS module
question: Can nature reduce pollution?
plain: Extends the catchment model to pollution, so you can see how much Nature-based Solutions reduce nutrients, PFAS and other substances in rivers and groundwater.

name: Sponge Valley
question: Can a game teach it?
plain: A browser game where children and adults build a valley that can soak up floods and survive droughts, and discover why nature is such a good engineer.
